# NON-PARAMETRIC TESTS

```{r}
# SIGN TEST
# 1 sample // paired test of medians

Nsuccesses <- 6
Ntrials <- 15
binom.test(Nsuccesses, Ntrials, alternative = "two.sided",conf.level=0.95)
# result p=0.6072 > 0.05 -> do not reject H0 -> no significant amount of successes

# WILCOXON SIGNED RANK TEST
Nright <- rpois(Ntrials,4.87)
Ndiff <- rnorm(Ntrials, mean=(5.04-4.87),sd=1)
Nleft <- round(Nright+Ndiff)
 wilcox.test(Nright, Nleft, paired = TRUE, exact = TRUE)

 # WILCOXON RANKED SUM

```

```{r}
#install.packages("ggplot2")
#install.packages("dplyr")
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1 SAMPLE T TEST
N_observations <- 100
themean <- 7.1
thesd <- 2.5
theassumption <- 5
df1 <- tibble(NrCookies = round(pmax(rnorm(N_observations, mean=themean,sd=thesd),0)))
one.samp.t.test <- t.test(df1, mu=theassumption)
```
